about: The project's open to-dos, tied to the shared spec (specs/001-superintelligence-homepage): issues carry REQ-0xx labels for the requirements they serve. Loaded once into an empty tracker from the Project page. Owners are matched to admin accounts by username or display name.

milestones.name: Week 9 homework
milestones.description: Working agreement, initial spec and contract, submitted in Canvas and emailed to Paul.

milestones.name: Live site
milestones.description: Deployed on Vercel with Neon, feeds harvesting, both of us admins. Shared with the class at least 2 weeks before the presentation.

milestones.name: Bake-off
milestones.description: Both versions of the homepage experience built to the contract and judged by CLEF or JEV.

issues.title: Settle the [confirm] items in the working agreement
issues.description: Chat tool, check-in days, spending cap, and both Confirmed columns in the roles table. See docs/WORKING_AGREEMENT.md.

issues.title: Write the initial spec
issues.description: Done with Spec Kit: specs/001-superintelligence-homepage/spec.md under .specify/memory/constitution.md.

issues.title: Clarify REQ-020: where the agent log lives
issues.description: Spec open question. John's build has it in the app (Agent log page with typed vs pasted tracking). Run /speckit-clarify and record the answer.

issues.title: Clarify REQ-010: how long sessions last
issues.description: "Stay signed in until they sign out" needs a length to be testable. John's build uses 30 days.

issues.title: Approve CONTRACT.md v0.5 and constitution 1.2.0
issues.description: v0.5: one set of plan documents, build interfaces in docs/INTERFACES.md, review optional (constitution 1.2.0), proposed comparison criteria. Both tick the change log.

issues.title: Reconcile the root plan files with docs/
issues.description: Done: one set at the root (spec, constitution, CONTRACT.md, WORKING_AGREEMENT.md); John's build interfaces in docs/INTERFACES.md.

issues.title: Submit Week 9 homework in Canvas and by email to Paul
issues.description: Once the three files are merged to main: text entry with the three GitHub links, and the same links by email.

issues.title: Give the Vercel GitHub app access to the repo
issues.description: github.com/apps/vercel → Configure → Matt-Baxter → add superintelligence-home-page. docs/DEPLOY.md step 1.

issues.title: Merge the open pull requests
issues.description: Setup PR first, then harvest-and-admin, then this project tracker, once Preflight is green.

issues.title: Create the Vercel project and add Neon
issues.description: Import the repo, add Neon (free plan, US East) for all environments. docs/DEPLOY.md steps 2–3.

issues.title: Set CRON_SECRET and APP_TZ, then deploy
issues.description: docs/DEPLOY.md steps 4–5.

issues.title: Sign up first on the live site, harvest, and enable catalog sources
issues.description: Admin → Harvest all now, then Add sources → Source catalog. Fix or delete feeds that fail.

issues.title: Ask Paul for the presentation date
issues.description: The live site has to be shared with the class at least 2 weeks before it.

issues.title: Agree on bake-off criteria and weights
issues.description: In CONTRACT.md → Decision point (six proposed criteria). Score on /m/decide.

issues.title: Start the v0 bake-off branch
issues.description: bakeoff/v0-john with the starter prompt in docs/V0.md.

issues.title: Start the Claude bake-off branch
issues.description: bakeoff/claude-matt from main.

issues.title: Keep writing Agent log entries in our own words
issues.description: Whenever the agent gets something wrong. Written by us, not generated.

issues.title: Plan Matt's build with /speckit-plan and /speckit-tasks
issues.description: Record the stack and tasks for bakeoff/claude-matt; every task names its REQ IDs.

issues.title: Plan John's v0 build against the spec
issues.description: Starter prompt in docs/V0.md; trace each REQ in docs/SPEC_TRACE.md.

issues.title: Run every acceptance scenario on both builds (SC-008)
issues.description: Tick each user story for both builds in CONTRACT.md → Acceptance tests.

issues.title: Check the live feed stays on superintelligence (SC-004)
issues.description: Both judge a sample of 20 live stories; at least 18 must be about superintelligence. Admin → Moderation → Left out of the feed shows what the filter dropped.
